posts.title: Mission District Condo Trends — Q2 2026
posts.summary: Condo values in 94110 firmed up this quarter as tech hiring rebounded. The details.
posts.bodyHtml:
After a soft winter, Mission District condos found their footing in Q2. A rebound in Bay Area tech hiring brought buyers back to the market, and the median condo price climbed to $1.145M.

Inventory stayed tight

Active listings actually fell month over month, keeping upward pressure on well-located units near BART and the 24th Street corridor.

If you've been waiting on the sidelines, the combination of firming prices and thin supply suggests the window for a patient, discounted entry is closing.
